Memepedia

Memepedia is a encyclopedia For Saying Words In Jokes And Gags, As To Make The People Lol.

It Started Out As A Project Known As "The Meme Wiki".

Which, To Summerise Garbage Memories, Was A Wiki Like Nupedia, Or A Site In Which Almost No Content Could Be Posted

Eventually However, The Meme Wiki Got A Rebranding Per Se, Into This Site You Are Using. A Sidebar Got Added, IMGs could be uploaded, An Editor Was Added, And Anyone Could 'make' an article.
